name: Balance Walk
description: With your arms out to the sides at shoulder height, walk slowly in a straight line, one foot just in front of the other; as you step, lift the back knee and pause for a second before stepping forward.

source.title: National Institute on Aging (Go4Life): 3 balance exercises for older adults
source.note: Described in our own words. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Stand tall, arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Pick a spot ahead to look at.

prescription.note: Pick a spot ahead to look at; hold a wall or counter if you need it.

keyframes.name: Right foot in front
keyframes.cue: Arms out to the sides; step the right foot in front.

keyframes.name: Lift the back knee
keyframes.cue: Lift the left knee and pause for a second.

keyframes.name: Lift the back knee
keyframes.cue: Lift the right knee and pause for a second.
